features.name: Marketing homepage
features.current_verified_behavior: Public responsive marketing page on www with current inbound-deal-system copy.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Live reachability does not prove conversion or source canonicality.
features.owner_question: Is this current positioning the approved production narrative?

features.name: Legal and privacy pages
features.current_verified_behavior: Privacy, terms, and data-deletion information pages are reachable.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Legal adequacy was not assessed.
features.owner_question: Which specialist owns legal review and retention language?

features.name: Partner start / Click-to-Scale entry
features.current_verified_behavior: Partner/start route and branded entry surfaces exist in code.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Live partner-domain and configuration parity are not fully proven.
features.owner_question: Which partner domains and configurations are canonical?

features.name: Signup and login
features.current_verified_behavior: Email/password login and signup surfaces exist; protected routes redirect anonymous users to login.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Authenticated success, failure, MFA, social login, lockout, and recovery completion were not exercised.
features.owner_question: What is the approved production authentication acceptance matrix?

features.name: Password recovery
features.current_verified_behavior: Client exchanges fragment tokens for a session.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Tokens remain in fragment on session exchange failure.
features.owner_question: Must recovery be isolated from all third-party scripts?

features.name: Workspace and entitlement recovery
features.current_verified_behavior: App layout resolves authentication, workspace, and billing context before rendering product surfaces.
features.problems_or_contradictions: One recovery branch depends on a header the proxy does not set.
features.owner_question: What is the single source of truth for active workspace selection?

features.name: Onboarding draft and plan
features.current_verified_behavior: Captures profile, company, market, offer, budget, audience, and plan inputs.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Full draft PII is globally persisted in localStorage without TTL/user binding.
features.owner_question: Which draft fields truly need browser persistence?

features.name: Campaign creation and plan
features.current_verified_behavior: Creates campaign and campaign-plan data through campaign/build routes.
features.problems_or_contradictions: End-to-end production persistence and schema parity were not proven.
features.owner_question: What campaign-plan contract is authoritative?

features.name: AI builder command
features.current_verified_behavior: Command, copy-assistant, and section-assistant APIs support guided building.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Current model/provider behavior and spend controls were not live tested.
features.owner_question: Which AI actions require explicit cost confirmation?

features.name: Funnel generation
features.current_verified_behavior: Generates and edits campaign funnel content.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Published output can surface internal template labels and weak copy.
features.owner_question: What copy-quality gate blocks publication?

features.name: Funnel publication
features.current_verified_behavior: Publishes a public funnel at a slug.
features.problems_or_contradictions: The safely viewed live funnel contained internal template labels, repetition, and grammar defects.
features.owner_question: Should publication require customer-safe copy validation and preview approval?

features.name: Public lead form
features.current_verified_behavior: Collects name, email, phone and explicit SMS consent.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Submission was not performed; write path remains source-only.
features.owner_question: What production-safe synthetic-lead mechanism is approved?

features.name: Lead capture API
features.current_verified_behavior: Validates and inserts canonical lead then queues side effects.
features.problems_or_contradictions: A secret-gated load-test bypass can skip Turnstile/rate limits while retaining real effects.
features.owner_question: Must test traffic be forced into an isolated non-provider tenant?

features.name: Lead alert notification
features.current_verified_behavior: Queued job attempts an internal SMS/lead alert.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Failure truth and idempotency are not durably separated from other effects.
features.owner_question: What is the required retry/duplicate policy for each notification?

features.name: Meta CAPI lead event
features.current_verified_behavior: Queued job attempts Meta lead conversion delivery.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Per-effect durable completion/retry proof is missing.
features.owner_question: What conversion idempotency key and retention policy are authoritative?

features.name: GHL CRM lead sync
features.current_verified_behavior: Searches/creates contact and creates opportunity, recording sync event state.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Mapping integrity, request timeout, idempotency, and failed-event retry consumption are deficient or unproven.
features.owner_question: Is GHL the canonical CRM and what cross-workspace mapping invariant is mandatory?

features.name: Static creative generation
features.current_verified_behavior: Queues or runs static creative generation with media validation and QA metadata.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Provider worker/runtime, client DTO exposure, pass state, and spend behavior not live proven.
features.owner_question: Which provider path is canonical and what proof gates selection?

features.name: Video / UGC generation
features.current_verified_behavior: Supports Higgsfield/HeyGen-style video generation and job tracking.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Dedicated worker deployment unproven; temp cleanup absent.
features.owner_question: Who owns a supervised worker and queue-lag SLO?

features.name: Creative intake and selection
features.current_verified_behavior: Collects intake and stores selected ad/UGC asset choices.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Selection permits zero UGC while launch requires at least one.
features.owner_question: What is the authoritative launchable-selection invariant?

features.name: Creative preview and provenance
features.current_verified_behavior: Renders creative previews with internal asset/provider metadata supplied to a client component.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Provider IDs, storage paths, prompts/hashes, and raw status are over-serialized.
features.owner_question: Which fields are customer-safe?

features.name: Billing status and entitlements
features.current_verified_behavior: Resolves plan, subscription state, capture/launch/generation entitlements.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Deployed webhook/schema state and lifecycle transitions were not live proven.
features.owner_question: Which billing state machine is product-authoritative?

features.name: Checkout and billing portal
features.current_verified_behavior: Creates checkout or portal sessions.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Not invoked due spend/external-mutation boundary.
features.owner_question: What isolated Stripe test-project proof is required before launch?

features.name: Generation credits
features.current_verified_behavior: Tracks credit balance/ledger and controlled overdrafts.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Concurrency and live ledger correctness were not tested.
features.owner_question: What is the approved overdraft/refund/reconciliation policy?

features.name: Meta connection and OAuth
features.current_verified_behavior: Creates signed OAuth state, stores encrypted token, returns to app.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Backslash redirect, scope/version split, and live connection state remain concerns.
features.owner_question: Which Meta version/scopes and redirect allowlist are approved?

features.name: Meta account/page/pixel selection
features.current_verified_behavior: Loads and stores Meta selections for launch.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Provider contract and tenant-scoped live behavior not exercised.
features.owner_question: What must be revalidated at every launch?

features.name: Campaign launch
features.current_verified_behavior: Launch service validates and performs Meta campaign operations with persisted state.
features.problems_or_contradictions: No provider mutation was run; idempotency and current API compatibility remain unproven.
features.owner_question: What constitutes a transactionally confirmed launch?

features.name: Launch progress and success
features.current_verified_behavior: Launching and success pages present a launch result.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Success can be rendered from query parameters without persisted successful launch.
features.owner_question: Should unknown/absent launch state always fail closed?

features.name: Dashboard and performance
features.current_verified_behavior: Dashboard API/page aggregate campaign and performance state.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Authenticated data, empty/error states, and active-workspace isolation not live tested.
features.owner_question: Which KPIs and freshness labels are authoritative?

features.name: Optimization and action suggestions
features.current_verified_behavior: Creates optimization suggestions, draft actions, and runtime context.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Provider execution and approval boundaries not live proven.
features.owner_question: Which actions are advisory versus auto-executable?

features.name: System job queue
features.current_verified_behavior: Persists, claims, retries, logs, streams, and completes asynchronous work.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Lease heartbeat absent; job reads use user ownership instead of active organization.
features.owner_question: What is the single durable job/tenant/idempotency model?

features.name: Operator command center
features.current_verified_behavior: Shows issue/readiness/operational summaries.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Can show zeros on unavailable data and contains hard-coded/stale readiness proof.
features.owner_question: Should every score expose source, freshness, and unavailable state?

features.name: Client error telemetry and issues
features.current_verified_behavior: Records bounded/scrubbed client events and exposes issue prompts to operators.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Untrusted instruction text reaches a downloadable Codex prompt.
features.owner_question: Must public telemetry be isolated from executable/operator prompt contexts?

features.name: Launch monitor
features.current_verified_behavior: Provides launch monitoring surface.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Live telemetry, freshness, and failure-state behavior not exercised.
features.owner_question: What events make this monitor authoritative?

features.name: Support and feedback
features.current_verified_behavior: Feedback and support-ticket routes exist.
features.problems_or_contradictions: No external ticket was created; current provider configuration is unproven.
features.owner_question: Which support system is canonical?

features.name: Activation and customer-success tracking
features.current_verified_behavior: Activation events, cancellation intent, value reports, and checklists exist.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Some operational reads fail silent; live schema/retention not proven.
features.owner_question: Which events and checklist states drive owner decisions?

features.name: Growth Agent suite
features.current_verified_behavior: Fifteen research, mission, outbound, approvals, calls, reporting, and memory pages exist.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Mostly code-surface proof; persistence, entitlements, and E2E utility not proven.
features.owner_question: Is Growth Agent in current product scope or a future/experimental surface?

features.name: Sales Copilot suite
features.current_verified_behavior: Ten-plus analysis, calls, objections, playbooks, setters, evals, and reporting pages exist.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Mostly code-surface proof; persistence, entitlements, and E2E utility not proven.
features.owner_question: Is Sales Copilot in current product scope or a future/experimental surface?

features.name: Meta data deletion callback
features.current_verified_behavior: Verifies request and returns confirmation URL/code.
features.problems_or_contradictions: No deletion, durable request record, queue, completion state, or freshness guard found.
features.owner_question: What data-deletion SLA, scope, and specialist review are required?

features.current_verified_behavior: Reports readiness for selected ad/AI/payment providers.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Registry is incomplete and some readiness is environment-presence only.
features.owner_question: What does ready mean for every provider and how fresh must proof be?

features.current_verified_behavior: Can establish QA auth state or create Stripe test proof when enabled.
features.problems_or_contradictions: Production prohibition and cookie protections are incomplete; not executed.
